messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The user is unable to import the latest supplier reports into the system.
  quote: I’m having trouble pulling the latest supplier reports into the system — any idea what might be blocking it?
- problem: The customer is concerned that integrating supplier portal data into the Keelwater system might disrupt their existing reporting workflows.
  quote: can your system pull in supplier data without breaking our existing reporting?

response.content: {"title": "Supplier data integration issues", "problem_statement": "Users cannot import the latest supplier reports into the platform. They fear that integrating this data will disrupt existing reporting workflows."}
